comment: Current claude's queued-prompt format, hand-written from the canary-observed shapes: a prompt typed into the busy pane is recorded as a uuid-less queue-operation enqueue line (skipped by the parser, leaving a seq gap), the interrupt marker frees the turn, and the prompt is replayed as a plain user line (promptSource queued). The replay matches no send, so it is external input landing on main, and its reply follows it there.
